To use By Rotation properly the first time:

Sign up & set up profile: Download the app, tap the profile icon, hit Get Started, sign up (email/Apple/Facebook), add photo, location, and bio, then complete ID verification via Stripe so you can rent.
First‑time discount: As a new user, you get 15% off your first rental (orders over £20); it’s automatically applied at checkout, no code needed, and must be used within 30 days (max £15 off).
If you’re renting: Record a clear video of the item as soon as you receive it and again right before returning it, showing the full garment and any marks. Notify the lender immediately if it arrives damaged or you damage it during your rental.
If you’re lending: Take timestamped videos and photos before sending the item and on the day it’s returned, showing all angles and any existing flaws. This protects you if there’s a damage dispute.

If a rental isn’t right for you (e.g., fit or condition), you may be able to get a refund as app credit, depending on the lender’s refund policy.

Fit issues: Refunds are only offered if the lender allows them; they’re issued as By Rotation credit only, not cash.
Poor condition/misrepresented: Take photos, message the lender the day it arrives, return it within 24 hours, then submit a refund request in the app.
